name: UF-style-wasteland
note: wasteland — 1988 Wasteland CRPG portrait: EGA palette with Bayer dither, 128x128. — unfake grid snap (true model grid, reduced to the canvas), despeckle 1. Twin of FACTORY/style-wasteland.  (sample: seed 1552)

form.subject: a (post-apocalyptic desert ranger:1.3), (goggles:1.2), holding a rifle
form.negative: (3d render, realistic, photograph:1.3), (blurry:1.2), smooth gradient, (antialiased:1.1), jpeg artifacts, (text, watermark, signature:1.3), (full body:1.2), cropped head, (multiple faces:1.2)
